nodes.name: ReadLease
nodes.role: read the lease agreement the user names to find the monthly rent amount and due date

nodes.name: ReadPaymentHistory
nodes.role: read the record of past rent payments the user names to confirm what has already been paid

nodes.name: CheckNextMonthRent
nodes.role: compare the rent due for the next month against the payment history to determine whether that month's rent is paid, unpaid, or set up incorrectly

nodes.name: UpdateRentPayment
nodes.role: set or change the scheduled rent payment for the next month to the amount the lease states

nodes.name: ReportRentStatus
nodes.role: tell the user the rent status for the next month and whether the scheduled payment was changed
